items.title: #Magic coach Sean Sweeney also didn't have a timeline to share when I asked about Izaiyah Nelson, who is 4 months removed from a fractured left ankle.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
#Magic coach Sean Sweeney also didn't have a timeline to share when I asked about Izaiyah Nelson, who is 4 months removed from a fractured left ankle.

"He's progressing, doing some on-court stuff here, a little bit at a time," Sweeney said.

He added the work is "just minimal."

quote.author: Jason Beede
quote.text:
#Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Paolo Banchero (right high ankle sprain) is progressing but “no timeline right now.”

Although we didn’t see Banchero on the court during the media-viewing session of shootaround, Sweeney said Banchero is doing well and in good spirits today.
